summary: Frontend-only regression + feature testing of the updated Timeline section on Carlos Sibaja's portfolio. Verified label '02 / TIMELINE', heading 'Engineering Journey', intro text, all 8 milestones in exact order with correct titles/dates, item-2 note 'Expected Graduation: 2027', expandable Role details on Manufacturing Engineer (6 bullets, toggle open/close), timeline-cobot-link opens shared project-modal with cobot-case-study, modal closes via modal-close-btn, no placeholders in timeline, no console errors observed, nav-timeline scrolls to section, alternating rail visible on desktop 1440px, mobile 390px stacks to left rail with readable content.

Milestone key uses index; safe here since TIMELINE is static.
